key_features: Safe and Sturdy Creme Brulee Torch: The safety lock could prevent accidental ignition. Also the ergonomic design provides comfort to your hand and keep away from the flame; the aluminum alloy material adopted makes it more resistant and sturdy, ensuring the longevity (Note: After each use, please turn the flame adjustment valve to the lowest level(OFF Position), and engaging the safety lock for indicent ignition)

Refillable and Portable: TBTeek butane torch lighter can be refilled after running out of butane, with three butane adapters included, it's compatible with all types of butane tanks whether with long or short nozzle. Then this mini butane torch is small and lightweight, which make it easy to hold.(Butane gas not included)

Versatile: Features an adjustable flame control function to customize the intensity of the flame according to your needs (Max 1371 °C/2500 °F), such as caramelizing food, soldering DIY jewelry, Cooking, BBQ, Baking, Brulee, Creme, DIY Soldering, Bar Cocktails, Camping, and Crafts, making it an essential tool for hobbyists and professionals alike

Continuously Flame Mode: Light up with piezo ignition technology, press the ignition button to light up fire, rotate clockwise at the same time, then it will keep fire without needing to always keep pressing the button, free your hands during the intricate tasks

Perfect Gift Ideas: TBTeek small torch lighter can not be used in all indoor or outdoor cooking occasions, it can also be a great gift for your loved ones. The simple operation and versatility features make it universal for cooking lovers, craftsman, or outdoor camping enthusiasts, making any occasion special with a practical tool they'll love to use

Note: Please use only high-purity butane fuel to fill the torch (85% purity or above), and before the first fill, please purge all air inside the torch, since low-purity butane mixed with air will result in a weak or unstable flame. Besides, when you see excess gas escaping from the torch filling valve while filing the torch, that means the torch is fully filled. Continuance will cause overpressure.
